svg.title: svjeez
svg.desc: A pencil test on a sheet of animation paper. svjeez is written in ink with the line 'draw in TSX, get one animated SVG'. A sleeping orange ball wakes up and bounces across the page, leaving blue onion-skin ghosts, numbered keys and a dotted arc. An index card types out the TSX for the bounce while the ball bounces beside it, the lines highlighted as they run. The card is cranked through a little machine, which drops out bounce.svg; a list of what is not inside it, javascript, a runtime, a video file and dependencies, is struck out in red for 'just CSS keyframes.' The file lands in a README, a slide and a chat message, bouncing in each. Finally the ball grows, bows among sparkles, and 'your turn.' is written above it.

g.aria-label: draw in TSX, get one animated SVG
svjeez draws every frame in between
these run on their own. stop scrolling!
